question:
(i) Define electric field at a point and obtain the relation between electric field and force on a test charge.
(ii) A charge of $5\,\mu\text{C}$ experiences a force of $0.25\,\text{N}$ at a point in an electric field. Calculate the magnitude of the electric field at that point.

options.A:
(i) $\vec{E}=q\vec{F}$ and $\vec{F}=\frac{\vec{E}}{q}$; electric field is a scalar
(ii) $E=1.25\times10^{-6}\,\text{N C}^{-1}$
options.B:
(i) Electric field is force per unit positive test charge: $\vec{E}=\frac{\vec{F}}{q}$, hence $\vec{F}=q\vec{E}$
(ii) $E=\frac{0.25}{5\times10^{-6}}=5\times10^4\,\text{N C}^{-1}$
options.D:
(i) Electric field is work done per unit charge: $E=\frac{W}{q}$
(ii) $E=5\times10^{-5}\,\text{N C}^{-1}$
